idea-plugin.name: SVN Enhance Merge
idea-plugin.description:
Selective revision merge for Subversion working copies, in the style of TortoiseSVN's "Show Log / merge revisions".
  • Reuses the built-in Subversion plugin's branch picker and merge engine (no forked code).
  • Revision list with live filtering (message / path / author / revision / Bug-ID / date range), speed search and inline diff.
  • Per-revision merge status (already merged / alien / calculating) plus "[Already merged]" markers on the affected files.
  • Loads revisions page by page directly from the repository.
  • All pre-merge steps (local changes prompt, progress, conflict resolution, result tree) behave exactly like the IDE's built-in "Merge From".

Source code: github.com/wxingfu/SvnMergeEnhance (MIT License). Homepage: wxingfu.github.io.

Third-party: bundles LGoodDatePicker (MIT License) for the date pickers. The full license text ships in THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt inside the plugin distribution.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Entry point: a "Enhance Merge..." link injected into Version Controls | Subversion Working Copies Information, right below "Merge From...".
  • Revision picking with TortoiseSVN-style filtering, paging (+100 / +500 / Show All), speed search and per-revision merge status.
  • Settings page under Settings | Version Control | SVN Enhance Merge.
  • English and Simplified Chinese UI.
